method.process_count: sitecustomize startup records, PID/PPID tree; exclude kb.py entry
method.process_count_limitations: Counts Python interpreters that inherit PYTHONPATH and load sitecustomize; -S/-I, replaced environments, native processes and fork-only children are not covered. This is startup instrumentation, not an OS-wide process tracer. Counting runs are separate from uninstrumented timing runs.
